data: Tesla's diluted EPS was $1.08 in fiscal 2025, down from $2.04 in fiscal 2024, a decline of about 47.1% (a drop of $0.96 per share). Net income for fiscal 2025 was $3,855 million, of which $3,794 million was attributable to common stockholders after $61 million attributable to noncontrolling interests. For comparison, fiscal 2024 net income was $7,153 million, so total net income fell roughly 46% year over year.
